# Non Autoregressive Writing Pass

Revise a completed draft's title, headings and transitions with the whole piece in view.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Revisit a completed draft with global knowledge of its argument, then revise its title, subtitle, headings, paragraph heads, and paragraph-to-paragraph transitions. Use when display text no longer fits the finished work; when openings feel generic, abrupt, weak, or begin with a rejected alternative before reaching the point; when paragraphs are individually clear but do not build on one another; when a finished abstract needs a stronger first sentence; or when final sentences do not close one paragraph naturally or prepare the relation to the next.

Example request:

> Use non-autoregressive-writing-pass to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill non-autoregressive-writing-pass
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/non-autoregressive-writing-pass/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/non-autoregressive-writing-pass/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
